name: tremor-watch
description: Tremor Watch: how many market relationships stopped behaving this week.

interface.longDescription: Ask whether markets are under strain and get the Antevo Tremor Index: every week, how many of 753 relationships between markets stopped behaving, across equity regions, US sectors, credit, bonds, commodities, FX and crypto, and volatility. A pair has stopped behaving when its correlation is two standard deviations away from its own previous two years. This week against a normal Friday since 2001, banded Calm, Elevated, High or Severe; each family against its own normal; the new breaks of the last four weeks; any week's pairs; and every reading since 1997, for episodes such as 2008 or 2020. Derived statistics only, never prices. Descriptive, not a forecast. Public and read-only: no account, no sign-in, and no tool that can change anything.
defaultPrompt: Are markets under strain this week?
Which market relationships are breaking right now?
How does this week compare with 2008?

positive.description: This week's reading against a normal Friday. No account.
positive.prompt: Are markets under strain this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the Antevo Tremor Index for the week that ended on the latest Friday, with that date: how many times a normal Friday it is, its status (Calm, Elevated, High or Severe), its rank among Fridays since 2001, and which families are furthest above their own normal. It describes the reading and does not forecast prices.

positive.description: The pairs breaking this week, most unusual first. No account.
positive.prompt: Which market relationships are breaking right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists this week's breaking pairs by how unusual they are, each with the two markets, the family, whether they are coming apart or moving closer than usual, the correlation and z, and the week.

positive.description: A past episode from the record since 1997. No account.
positive.prompt: How does this week compare with 2008?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the 2008 period from the history (peaking in October 2008) and compares its peak, as a multiple of a normal Friday, with this week's reading, naming both dates.

positive.description: One market's relationships this week. No account.
positive.prompt: Is gold still moving with equities this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads this week's pairs that name Gold, including those against equity indices, and says for each whether the relationship is holding or breaking, with its correlation and z, and the week.

positive.description: The new breaks of the last four weeks in one family. No account.
positive.prompt: What has newly broken in bonds over the past month?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the new breaks of the last four weeks in the Bonds family, newest first, each with its week, the two markets, the direction and z, or says that there were none.

negative.description: No trading: the app cannot place orders or move money.
negative.prompt: Sell my S&P 500 ETF before the next crash.

negative.description: No forecasts or advice: the index is descriptive.
negative.prompt: Will the stock market crash next month?
Book me a table for dinner in Zurich tonight.

review.commerce_description: Antevo Tremor Watch does not sell products or take payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: four public, read-only tools for the weekly Antevo Tremor Index.
